Meanings of INFO, UNCHECKED, and SKIP.
The doctor refuses to follow a symlink that leaves the directory; a normal install reads PASS or FAIL.
The doctor never runs the sending-domain or HTTPS checks; cairn health reaches each once the site is adopted.
The doctor never runs the GitHub App or auth-store checks; no command checks either, so use the manual proof.

The report has exactly one skip, guard role wiring, because no custom roles are declared.

Section heading.
HTTPS: doctor never runs it, health confirms it, and http admin hits an opaque 403.
Fix: turn on Always Use HTTPS and keep HSTS on.
Section heading.
The guard refuses a request with a missing or mismatched CSRF token, usually a stale tab or blocked cookies.
Fix: open the sign-in page fresh, allow cookies, request a new link.
Section heading.
The guard refused a non-admin form whose Origin header did not match the site.
Fix: post from the site itself and check whether a proxy rewrites Origin.
Section heading.
Identity gate refused or threw, so no session started; logged with reason identity.
Fix: sign in through the gate again; otherwise check the gate and the guard log detail.
Section heading.
The gate confirmed you but your email is not on the roster; logged as auth.identity.unknown.
Fix: an owner adds the confirmed email through Manage editors.
Section heading.
No enabled sending subdomain means no sign-in email; doctor never runs it, health confirms it.
Fix: enable sending for the domain with wrangler and redeploy; the domain must match the sender.
Those commands use the Cloudflare sign-in the setup tool created on this machine.
Send failed for another reason: delivery error, binding misconfiguration, or custom sender failure.
Find the send_failed record and read its code and error fields.
Section heading.
The wrangler config lacks the EMAIL send_email binding or the AUTH_DB D1 binding.
Fix: declare both bindings in the wrangler config and redeploy.
Section heading.
Adapter declares a media bucket with no matching r2 binding; runs only when a bucket is configured.
Fix: declare an r2 binding matching the adapter bucketBinding and redeploy.
Section heading.
observability.enabled is not true, so structured logs go nowhere.
Fix: set observability.enabled to true and redeploy.
Section heading.
The check reads the framework config for checkOrigin false and the hooks for cairn guard.
Claim: a hand-built site with no svelte.config.js makes the check skip.
A scaffolded site always has svelte.config.js with checkOrigin false.
Ask a developer and the build-by-hand pointer.
Fix: code change in two files, the framework config and the hooks file.
Section heading.
A blanket no-referrer strips Origin so a same-origin form is rejected; admin already scopes it.
A PASS covers only the two files the check can read.
A skip means neither file was found.
Fix: serve strict-origin-when-cross-origin or same-origin; scope no-referrer to token routes.
Section heading.
PUBLIC_ORIGIN is unset, unparseable, or plain http on a non-local host.
Fix: set the canonical https origin in wrangler vars; dev.vars carries a local http override.
Section heading.
site.config.yaml fails to parse or validate, so concepts cannot resolve.
Fix: the error names the failing field; correct site.config.yaml.
Section heading.
The lockfile resolves svelte or kit below the floor; an older compiler can miscompile silently.
Fix: raise the package range to the floor and reinstall.
Section heading.
No command checks this until a later CLI release; run a tidy suggestion instead.
Tidy is enabled but no valid ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is reachable; only tidy is affected.
Fix: set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as a Worker secret or in dev.vars.
Section heading.
The site declares a stance but the served robots.txt does not carry it.
Something ahead of the origin, often a managed robots.txt, rewrites it; otherwise a developer fixes it.
Section heading.
No command checks four auth conditions; role wiring is still covered by the doctor.
AUTH_DB is missing, lacks tables, or has no owner row, so no link can be minted.
Claim: a scaffolded site skips this check instead of failing.
Fix: apply the auth schema, seed the owner row, confirm the AUTH_DB binding.
Migration 0000 creates the tables and 0004 adds the sign-in binding column.
AUTH_DB lacks migration 0004 so every sign-in fails; the site reports it on first attempt.
Fix: copy migration 0004 into the site migrations and apply it.
A row has an undeclared role: the person can sign in but is refused everywhere.
Fix: restore the role or set the person to a declared role.
Custom roles declared but the guard was not told, so it falls back to owner and editor.
Pointer to restricting admin access.
A stored email with capitals or spaces breaks the trimmed-lowercase assumption.
Fix: correct the row; editors added through the admin are always normalized.
Section heading.
No command checks the GitHub App.
Claim: confirm a commit authored by the bot lands on main.
Key parse, App authentication, token minting, or a repository read fails, so saves cannot commit.
Confirm the App is installed; otherwise the App id, installation id, or key in Worker secrets.
Pointer to rotating the App key.
Section heading.
A best-effort text check of the shared layout and catch-all route; a false trip is possible.
Fix: confirm the admin mount matches the canonical mount.
Section heading.
No tool checks the login probe; do the manual workers.dev and preview alias GET instead.
Fix: gate the workers.dev address or set workers_dev and preview_urls to false.
